messages.en:
{07 0e 00}I keep seeing this one
otter-looking guy on the
cape, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{06 01 00 07 08 09}
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Ma näen aina üht
saarmanägu tüüpi
neemel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{06 01 00 07 08 09}

messages.en:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Yeah, catching fish and
catching boys aren't so
different, really.{07 00 00}
{07 0e 00}Yes. Patience,{01 00 00 0a 00} good timing,{01 00 00 0a 00}
and the right mood are
key to both{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0c 00}I KNEW IT!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00} Fishing is
exactly like love!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Jah, kalade püüdmine ja
poiste püüdmine polegi
nii erinevad.{07 00 00}
{07 0e 00}Jah. Kannatlikkus,{01 00 00 0a 00} ajastus{01 00 00 0a 00}
ja õige meeleolu on
mõlemas võti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0c 00}MA TEADSIN!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00} Kalapüük on
täpselt nagu armastus!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}That's just terrible.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tee hee, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}I bet you thought I was
going to give you a {ff 00 00 07}fishing
rod{ff 00 00 00}, huh, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 1b 00}Well, too bad!{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm not one
of those girls who plays
games like that!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}See on lihtsalt kohutav.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Hihii, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}Vean kihla, et arvasid,
et annan sulle {ff 00 00 07}õnge-
ritva{ff 00 00 00}, mis, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 1b 00}Noh, kahju!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma pole üks
neist tüdrukutest, kes
selliseid mänge mängib!

messages.en:
{07 09 00}You can hear the waves!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Just put it to your ear!
messages.et:
{07 09 00}Sa kuuled laineid!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Pane see kõrva äärde!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hee hee! Different shells{01 00 00 0a 00}
are worth different
amounts, you know.
{07 14 00}Does that remind you of
something else,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hihii! Eri karbid{01 00 00 0a 00}
on eri palju
väärt, tead küll.
{07 14 00}Kas see ei meenuta sulle
midagi muud,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}What can I say about him?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 01 00}He's a total weirdo! {01 00 00 05 00}I don't
understand a thing he says.
{07 13 00}But he's so cute, I kinda
crush on him!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Mida temast öelda?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 01 00}Ta on veidrik! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma ei
saa aru, mida ta räägib.
{07 13 00}Aga ta on nii armas, et
olen temasse kiindunud!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}I heard he had a tragic
exfoliating accident that
turned him all deep!
{07 14 00}Now he's all like,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 02 00} "Fish don't
have feet, so they can't
tap dance, {01 00 00 05 00}maaaaaaaaaan!"{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Kuulsin, et tal oli
traagiline koorimisõnnetus,
mis tegi ta sügavaks!
{07 14 00}Nüüd on ta selline:{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 02 00} „Kaladel
pole jalgu, nii et nad ei
oska steppida, {01 00 00 05 00}semuuuuuu!”{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}

messages.en:
{07 16 00}At first, he seems like this
brainless surfer,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 19 00}but he's
actually a philosophotter.
{07 0e 00}I wonder what happened to
make him that way,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Alguses tundub ta ajuvaba
surfarina,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 19 00}aga tegelikult
on ta filosoof-saarmas.
{07 0e 00}Huvitav, mis juhtus, et ta
selliseks sai,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}If you want to look alluring
and mysterious on the
beach,
{07 19 00}just look like you're way
too busy collecting shells
to care.
{07 14 00}Why? {01 00 00 0a 00}'Cause desperation is
the stinkiest perfume of
them all, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui tahad rannas välja näha
ahvatlev ja salapärane,

{07 19 00}näe lihtsalt välja, nagu
oleksid karpe korjates liiga
hõivatud, et hoolida.
{07 14 00}Miks? {01 00 00 0a 00}Sest meeleheide on
kõige haisvam parfüüm
üldse, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
